body.name: certified rational spectral handle \(\mathsf C_{\mathbb Q}\)
body.construction: Compose outward-rounded rational covariance and inverse enclosures with a deterministic Hermitian gap and invariant-subspace routine, then bound projector-product norms by interval matrix multiplication and certified singular-value enclosures. Allocate arithmetic error at each reached operation from the unused fraction of the public statistical tolerance and increase \(p_{\mathrm{bit}}\) until every interval is separated from the decision boundary.
